name: groodle-app
description: Capacitor 6 Android shell for Groodle (the static game in ../groodle). The web build stays the source of truth; `npm run prebuild` snapshots it into ./www with offline-safe relative paths, then Capacitor bundles www into the APK.

scripts.sync: npm run prebuild && cap sync android
scripts.open: npm run sync && cap open android
